name: 02_triggered_preserves_count
description: Guard: when is_triggered=True, the stop-check block is skipped (already exited). Count preserved, hit=False.
derivation: is_triggered=True -> the `if armed and not triggered:` guard fails on the SECOND clause (not triggered is False). The block is skipped entirely; below_stop_count is preserved at 1. Hit is False. The other inputs are irrelevant once triggered (the magnitude floor IS breached at current_return -10.0 <= -2.10, but prob_underperforming 5.0 is well below MC_BREAKDOWN_THRESHOLD(60.0) so the breakdown gate would NOT confirm anyway) -- is_triggered=True short-circuits all of it.
